title: PhotoHacks - Learn photography by playing (trailer)
description:
Have you always wanted to learn photography? PhotoHacks is a free game where you learn it by taking photos: a real camera simulator, a hands-on photography academy and an arcade full of challenges, all in a living park.

You'll learn to control:
- The aperture: wide open to blur the background, stopped down to get everything sharp.
- The shutter speed: freeze a runner, or let motion show, and pan to keep your subject sharp against a streaked background.
- Zoom and perspective, ISO for when the light fades, and how streetlights turn into stars at night.
- Manual focus with classic cameras: a rangefinder and a twin-lens reflex.

Play it at your own pace: stroll around the park and photograph whatever you like, or take the whole course through the ten Academy lessons and the thirty arcade levels.

100% free, no ads, no microtransactions, no accounts, and it plays offline. Available in English and Spanish.

Download it free for Windows, Linux and macOS, or play it in your browser: https://geese-bumps.itch.io/photohacks
Open source: https://github.com/Ganso/proyecto-paparazzi
